Details 
 Women’s Bag in Genuine Bovine Leather with Interwoven Design 
 Make a bold fashion statement with this women’s bag crafted from genuine bovine leather, featuring an elegant interwoven front design that adds depth and exclusivity. Perfect for everyday wear, this bag combines sophisticated craftsmanship with modern practicality.
 Why you’ll love it: 
- Premium bovine leather – Soft, durable, and built to last.
- Intricate interwoven front design – A unique handcrafted detail that stands out.
- Different leather contrasts – Adds dimension and a sophisticated touch.
- Zipper opening – Secure closure to keep your essentials safe.
- Handles with fabric and decorative cord – Blends comfort with stylish accents.
- Spacious and versatile – Perfect for daily use, work, or special outings.
 Designed for fashion-forward women, this bag is as functional as it is stylish. Whether you’re pairing it with casual or dressy outfits, the interwoven leather contrasts and decorative accents make it an elegant yet practical choice.
 Upgrade your accessory game with this bovine leather bag, where luxury meets everyday convenience!
 Materials
 Bovine: Bovine leather is renowned for its strength and versatility, making it ideal for a wide range of products. Its durability and classic appearance have made it a staple in both fashion and everyday items.
 Care
 Bovine leather is strong and versatile.
- Brush off dust and dirt with a soft cloth or brush.
- Wipe the handbag with a damp cloth for a deeper clean.
- Apply a leather cream to keep the material hydrated and prevent cracking.
- Lightly polish the handbag to maintain its luster.
- Store in a dust bag and avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading.
